_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.0 (part 7): alternating hint lines, rumors, field notes and weather forecasts.
Read by tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_hints.py, which writes src/data/hoenn_hints.h (the tables
src/hoenn_hints.c reads), data/scripts/hoenn_hints.inc (one wrapper script per NPC, plus every
text) and swaps each listed NPC's script in its map.json for the wrapper. Re-runs are idempotent.
lines: reusable extra lines. kind is tip / story / rumor / forecast (documentation only, except
that rumor lines name a rumor and forecast lines show today's or tomorrow's forecast). 'if' is a
list of conditions that must all hold. Texts are word-wrapped by the generator; a list of strings
is one text box per string.
rumors: 'found' says when the player has found it (all conditions hold); NPCs then say 'after'
instead of 'before'. The field-notes researcher counts found rumors and gives the first unfound
rumor's 'notes' as a vague hint. Later parts add their own rumors here (roadmap rule).
npcs: the NPCs that get extra lines. A global toggle (VAR_HOENN_HINT_TOGGLE) flips on every talk
to one of them: one talk runs the NPC's own script, the next their first line whose conditions
hold (or their own script again if none does). always: true skips the toggle (the line, when one
holds, always comes first). 'index' picks the object when several share the script.
forecasts: {map, if, text}. A forecast applies when the map's special-weather day is today or
tomorrow (STR_VAR_1 = TODAY / TOMORROW) and its conditions hold, and only in the region of the
map the player is in. Shown by forecast lines and by every TV (before its normal show). Only
forecast weather that matters: something rare depends on it (2.0-plan section 2f).

{stamps_below: n} (Hoenn badges) {badges_min: n} {badges_below: n} (HnS's 16 badges)
{caught: SPECIES} {not_caught: SPECIES} {level_cap: true} (HnS's level cap option is on).

text: The DAY-CARE couple on ROUTE 34 will raise two POKéMON for you.
Leave two that get along, and one day they may find an EGG!
The BUG-CATCHING CONTEST in JOHTO's NATIONAL PARK runs every day.
Catch the best BUG POKéMON you can find and you might win a prize!

TIP_CLOCK.text: Did you know? The clock on the wall in any POKéMON CENTER lets you set the day and the time.

text: With the LEVEL CAP on, your POKéMON stop growing at the next GYM LEADER's level.
Every BADGE you win raises the cap a little.
Some POKéMON only come out when the weather turns.
Rainy days and stormy days bring out different faces in the grass!

TIP_REMINDER_JK.text: A man in BLACKTHORN CITY can make POKéMON remember moves they've forgotten.

TIP_NAMERATER_JK.text: The NAME RATER in GOLDENROD CITY can give your POKéMON a better nickname.

TIP_REMINDER_H.text: In FALLARBOR TOWN there's a MOVE REMINDER. He helps POKéMON remember forgotten moves.

TIP_NAMERATER_H.text: The NAME RATER in SLATEPORT CITY can change your POKéMON's nicknames.

text: A guru in MOSSDEEP CITY reads POKéMON's minds.
For STAR PIECES, he can bring out a POKéMON's hidden potential.
See the rocks south of ROUTE 41? There's a gap with a huge whirlpool in it.
Past it is the TIDAL STRAIT. Folks say it runs all the way to HOENN, but nobody gets through that whirlpool.
The whirlpool south of ROUTE 41 has calmed! Did you see it on TV?
SURF through the gap in the rocks and follow the TIDAL STRAIT. It comes out on HOENN's ROUTE 105.
You SURFED the TIDAL STRAIT all the way to HOENN? The sailors here will be talking about that for years!
MR. BRINEY says the sea west of ROUTE 105 is calm again. The TIDAL STRAIT runs from there all the way to JOHTO!
SECRET POWER works here too, not just in HOENN. There are hollow trees in ILEX FOREST and VIRIDIAN FOREST.
And cracked rock on ROUTE 45 and inside MT. MOON. Make a SECRET BASE in one!
The old legendary sites are open again: the desert ruins, SKY PILLAR, even the caves under the sea.
The POKéMON that slept there are gone. TRAINERS are making SECRET BASES in them!
Hmph. Wild CYNDAQUIL turn up in the BURNED TOWER at night.
Go catch one if you want. Mine will still burn it to a crisp.
Hmph. Something keeps stealing a fisherman's bait at the LAKE OF RAGE.
It's a wild TOTODILE. Bring a GOOD ROD if you want it. Mine's stronger.
Hmph. There's a wild CHIKORITA in a meadow off ROUTE 46.
Follow the sweet smell by day. Mine will never lose to it.
PROF. ELM dropped by today.
He says CHIKORITA families sunbathe in a meadow off ROUTE 46.
He thought you'd like to see them, since yours started it all!
PROF. ELM dropped by today.
He says TYPHLOSION nest in the BURNED TOWER at night.
He thought you'd like to see them, since yours started it all!
PROF. ELM dropped by today.
He says a FERALIGATR raises its TOTODILE in the LAKE OF RAGE.
He thought you'd like to see them, since yours started it all!
Our lab's TOTODILE is still loose somewhere.
A fisherman at the LAKE OF RAGE keeps losing his bait. That's our guess!
It knows our lab's smell. If it sees you, it'll come to you!
Our lab's CHIKORITA is still loose somewhere.
I saw it run into the tall grass on ROUTE 46, by day.
It knows our lab's smell. If it sees you, it'll come to you!
Our lab's CYNDAQUIL is still loose somewhere.
Someone saw it by ECRUTEAK's BURNED TOWER, after dark.
It knows our lab's smell. If it sees you, it'll come to you!
The PROF. is writing about CHIKORITA on ROUTE 46.
There's a hidden meadow there. Have you seen them?
The PROF. is writing about TYPHLOSION in the BURNED TOWER.
They bring their young there at night. Have you seen them?
The PROF. is writing about a FERALIGATR in the LAKE OF RAGE.
It raises its TOTODILE in the south cove. Have you seen them?
My grandson BILL says BULBASAUR meet in a garden behind our house.
In the morning, slip through the trees above the overlook!
The NURSE keeps looking out at the rain.
She saw a CHARMANDER by NUGGET BRIDGE at dusk.
It was waiting in the rain. Its flame was so small…
PROF. OAK is said to give TRAINERS with all 16 BADGES a ticket for the ship to HOENN.
Ships leave from VERMILION's port.

STORY_NORMAN.text: NORMAN of PETALBURG only battles TRAINERS who already have four HOENN BADGES.

text: WATTSON won't battle until someone fixes the generator in NEW MAUVILLE.
He's looking for a TRAINER to help!
The MOSSDEEP GYM twins won't battle until the SPACE CENTER gets its meteorite back.
COZMO in FALLARBOR might know where one is.

STORY_WINONA.text: FORTREE's GYM LEADER WINONA has been out by the WEATHER INSTITUTE on ROUTE 119.

text: Every morning a SWAMPERT brings two MUDKIP to this pond to practice.
When they all dive, you'd better find some shelter!
Every morning, a GARDEVOIR guards a RALTS by the tall grass near PETALBURG.
Run up to them and they vanish! Walk slowly, with a POKéMON that really loves you.
Some evenings you can hear blades clashing behind the trees in the north-east corner.
TUESDAYS, THURSDAYS, SATURDAYS… the old contest days. Watch from the little path at the top of the park!
On some nights, folks here swear their own shadows grin at them.
If yours does, follow where it points. It only plays at night.
That SLOWKING down the well asks a riddle every day, a different one for each day of the week.
Solve them all and it tells you a whole prophecy. Grandpa KURT says it's about the sea.
There's a MUNCHLAX asleep in the trees by the first ash fields. It's been there for weeks!
The glassblower says he's working on something that could wake it.
Some mornings a SPINDA dances in the ash, up by the sign past the twins.
Only once a week, mind you. It's a shy one.
A SLAKING sleeps in the gap in the trees up north. NORMAN used to train back there.
It only ever gets up at noon. Then it's grumpy!

before: They say CASTFORM only show themselves when the weather turns.
Look around ROUTES 119, 120 and 123 when the sky turns!
CASTFORM.after: Somebody caught a CASTFORM! So it really does ride the weather near the WEATHER INSTITUTE.
notes: Something near the WEATHER INSTITUTE changes with the sky…
It only appears when the weather turns.

before: A fisherman swears ROUTE 119's river hides a POKéMON nobody else can find.
Only a few spots in the whole river, he says!
FEEBAS.after: So FEEBAS really lives in ROUTE 119's river! Only a handful of spots, too.
FEEBAS.notes: A shabby fish hides in a long river in HOENN. Only a few spots in it, and they change…

MASQUERAIN.before: In HOENN, MASQUERAIN only flutter out of the grass on rainy days.
MASQUERAIN.after: Somebody caught a MASQUERAIN in the rain! I knew those rainy days were worth it.
MASQUERAIN.notes: A bug with eye-patterned wings only comes out on HOENN's rainy days.

LAPRAS.before: Every Friday, a LAPRAS is said to sing deep down in UNION CAVE.
LAPRAS.after: Somebody met UNION CAVE's Friday LAPRAS! Its song is real after all.
LAPRAS.notes: Deep in a JOHTO cave, a song can be heard once a week. Which day was it…?

before: They say the only RALTS in HOENN lives on ROUTE 102, with a GARDEVOIR watching over it.
It won't let just anyone near.
RALTS.after: Someone earned that GARDEVOIR's trust! The RALTS on ROUTE 102 went with them.
notes: On a quiet HOENN route, a guardian reads the hearts of those who come near.
Come in the morning, and don't rush.

MACHAMP.before: The KARATE KING in MT. MORTAR spars with a wild MACHAMP every morning, they say.
MACHAMP.after: Somebody watched KIYO's morning match with that MACHAMP! Not a peep the whole time, I heard.
MACHAMP.notes: Deep in a JOHTO mountain, two fighters meet every morning. Watch quietly…

before: On TUESDAY, THURSDAY and SATURDAY evenings, the SCYTHER behind the NATIONAL PARK's trees duel.
They say a SCIZOR breaks it up!
SCIZOR.after: Somebody saw the NATIONAL PARK's SCIZOR! It's so fast, nobody had ever seen it properly.
SCIZOR.notes: In a JOHTO park, blades clash at dusk on the bug contest's old days.

before: They say a GENGAR hides in people's shadows at night, here in LAVENDER.
It leads you on a chase, and only the trainers it likes get to see it.
GENGAR.after: A GENGAR came out of somebody's shadow and went with them! LAVENDER's nights feel quieter now.
GENGAR.notes: In a KANTO town of quiet memorials, your shadow may laugh at night. Follow it.

before: The SLOWKING in the SLOWPOKE WELL asks one riddle a day, a new one each weekday.
Answer all seven and you'll hear its whole prophecy.
SAGE.after: Somebody heard the SLOWKING's whole prophecy! Something about lights under the sea.
SAGE.notes: A wise king in a JOHTO well asks one riddle each day of the week.

before: They say a MUNCHLAX on ROUTE 113 has been asleep so long, the ash is piling up on it.
MUNCHLAX.after: Somebody woke the sleepy MUNCHLAX on ROUTE 113! There was a grotto behind it the whole time.
MUNCHLAX.notes: A sleeping glutton blocks a path in the ash. A flute of glass might wake it.

before: They say a SPINDA dances in the falling ash on ROUTE 113, on a morning once a week.
SPINDA.after: Somebody saw the dancing SPINDA on ROUTE 113! Every one of them has different spots, you know.
SPINDA.notes: In the falling ash, on a morning once a week, someone dances alone.

before: They say a SLAKING sleeps across a path in PETALBURG WOODS. It only moves when the sun is highest.
SLAKING.after: Somebody caught the SLAKING in PETALBURG WOODS! NORMAN's old training spot is open again.
SLAKING.notes: In the woods by PETALBURG, a lazy giant only stirs at noon.
